title: Steam running only as a background process because of PowerTools

status.label: Clarify Steam behavior after PowerToys removal
status.detail: The reporter links Steam's background-only launch to a PowerToys update, but the issue does not establish whether Steam remained broken after PowerToys was uninstalled.

judgment.rationale: The reporter lists PowerToys 0.98.1, says Steam became impaired after a PowerToys update, and reports trying to disable utilities, uninstall, and reinstall. The discussion does not say whether Steam still failed after PowerToys was fully uninstalled or whether reinstalling PowerToys changed the result. Without that timeline or a current reproduction, no specific PowerToys component or fix can be justified.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.98.1 and says Settings initially would not open while changing Keyboard Manager remaps.
Steam reportedly stopped presenting its Library correctly and later ran only as a background process.
The reporter says Steam is the only affected program and lists disabling all utilities, uninstalling/reinstalling PowerToys, and Steam troubleshooting attempts.
The reporter's response insists PowerToys is responsible but does not state whether Steam remained broken after PowerToys was removed.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the current Steam result after PowerToys is fully exited or uninstalled and whether the problem returns when PowerToys is reinstalled; use that timeline to decide whether a focused reproduction is possible.

fix_assessment.rationale: If a current PowerToys process or module causes Steam to fail to initialize its UI, the interaction should be isolated and corrected; the current report does not yet identify a reproducible PowerToys path.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent a PowerToys interaction from blocking Steam startup
proposed_fixes.root_cause: An interaction between PowerToys and Steam startup or window initialization may leave Steam running without its normal UI, but the issue's timeline does not establish that PowerToys is the cause.
plan: Clarify whether Steam remained impaired after PowerToys was fully exited or uninstalled and whether the failure returned after reinstalling PowerToys.
If the issue is current, reproduce a clean Steam launch with PowerToys absent, then with PowerToys running and all utilities disabled.
Narrow the failing component or process interaction before proposing a code change; do not infer a Steam-specific fix from the update timing alone.
verification: Steam presents its Library and foreground window normally with PowerToys running.
Exiting or reinstalling PowerToys does not leave Steam stuck in a background-only state.
Other applications and PowerToys settings remain functional.

confidence.rationale: The report describes a serious symptom and temporal association but does not establish persistence after uninstall, a current reproduction, or a specific PowerToys component.

issue_context.summary: After a PowerToys update, Steam reportedly stopped presenting its Library normally and ran only in the background.
known_information: The reporter says Settings initially would not open while they were changing Keyboard Manager remaps.
Steam is the only application the reporter identified as affected.
The reporter tried disabling utilities and uninstalling/reinstalling PowerToys, but the result after each step is not stated.
inferences: The timing may indicate a PowerToys/Steam interaction, but the report does not establish causality or whether Steam remained impaired without PowerToys.
issue_context.analysis: The reporter's existing troubleshooting is acknowledged; the missing discriminator is the outcome after PowerToys was fully removed or exited. Ask for that specific timeline before requesting diagnostics or proposing a component-level change.
initial_investigation: Read the report and both comments; the only non-reporter comment is off-topic, and the reporter repeats that PowerToys must be responsible without adding a test result.
No linked fix or clearly covering issue is identified in the discussion.

information_gaps.information: Whether Steam still ran only in the background after PowerToys was fully exited or uninstalled, and whether reinstalling PowerToys caused the problem to return
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a PowerToys-dependent interaction from a Steam failure that persisted independently of PowerToys.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: State the Steam launch result after PowerToys was fully exited or uninstalled, and whether the failure returned after PowerToys was installed and launched again.

comment.body: You reported trying to disable all utilities and uninstall/reinstall PowerToys after Steam began running only in the background. Could you clarify whether Steam still had the same problem while PowerToys was fully exited or uninstalled, and whether it returned after PowerToys was installed and launched again?

actions.label: Compare Steam startup with PowerToys off and on

reproduce.title: Check Steam startup with PowerToys absent and running
setup: Record the current PowerToys and Steam versions and preserve the existing Steam and PowerToys settings.
steps: Fully exit PowerToys and launch Steam; check whether its Library window appears and operates.
Launch PowerToys with all utilities disabled and repeat the Steam launch check.
If Steam fails only with PowerToys running, enable utilities one at a time and record the first configuration that reproduces the failure.
reproduce.expected_result: Steam displays its normal Library UI; any reproducible difference is isolated to a specific PowerToys running state or utility.
